wps.notes: No load shedding with the grid up (U = L on grid-up steps) and the guard catches it; no grid buying inside the peak window to refill the reserve unless priced and labelled as such; reasons derived from the numbers (no 'likely outage' at 1-3 %, no 'cheaper' in the peak, no 'Wear > saving' next to a peak discharge); grid charge smoothed under the plan's own MDI cap. Plan SoC floor is the higher of BMS soc_min and the floor the delivered table/fallback holds (coordinate the value with delivery-twin's compile); reserve limited by battery discharge and inverter AC power (inverter.kw_ac read by the engine; flow-onboarding-09's form warning goes in the new equipment-checks.ts called with one line from the onboarding tab, because sites-onboarding owns site-form.ts), AMF auto-start covers the reserve instead of a 30-minute full-load battery reserve, 'reserve floor when an outage is likely' setting honoured, no double-charged shortfall. Battery: start below soc_min feasible, out-of-band relaxation only for the start, stale SoC widens sigma, sigma re-anchors at a full charge (fixes the 95 % for 48 h plans; prove Faisalabad/Lahore plans no longer cost more than native), BMS trust score low without an independent estimate, temperature derating (derate/imbalance/capacity_drop rules: add separate functions in alerts.py, shared with alerts-reports), cycle cap applied. MDI: month-start anchoring fixed, 'MDI rise' and cost breakdown itemise M2 instead of 'Not itemised', c_cal_hold as holding cost to the next peak, month_to_date treats missing minutes as unknown. Genset/off-grid: fuel carried between ticks (tank 0 = no tank info, not unlimited), follow cap with gen_charge_allowed False, GEN_CHARGE_SUPPORTED genset charging for the off-grid farm, no simultaneous charge/discharge, no curtailing free PV while the battery has room, genset marginal cost in the grid-tied terminal value. Time limits: a time-limited incumbent with a large gap does not supersede the last plan and the relaxed retry is labelled; surface time_limited_recent on the plan answer/page (the deterministic work limit/idle re-solve of HANDOFF 8.A.3 stays out). Plan page: Flags/override column and past-24-hour actuals in the table view, past slots legible, reason chips not one tab stop each and readable on a phone, re-solve feedback with the guard's reason, all-day slot written as 'all day'. Golden tests for every cost term changed.
